data.title: Growth with safety and community trust intact

findings.label: Scale
findings.body: Network grew from 6 to 9 cities; 580k flights in the latest year.

findings.label: Safety
findings.body: No attributable accidents; every response event entered review.

findings.label: Environment
findings.body: Ground travel displaced while energy per flight fell by 18%.

findings.label: Community
findings.body: 0.3 complaints per 1,000 flights, below the 0.5 commitment.

data.verdict: Scale doubled; the operating boundaries held.
